summary: Research half of #515: one retorsion schema, proved once, and its first two global-underminer instances. Schema (TruthCore.Logic.Retorsion): a typed Underminer (performance relation, feature of witnesses, thesis denying every witness); given the presupposition link (every performance yields, through a trace, a witness), the held position is inconsistent. Zero axioms; controls show link and holding are each needed; Underminer.thesis_false_of_performance records that any performance, not only the thesis's, suffices once the link holds. Eleatic instance: witnesses are being-respect pairs, trace is the opiner in the respect of the opinion; the link is definitionally OpiningIsBeingMovedReading, and ELEATIC-THESIS-SELF-REFUTING is unchanged (its frozen Challenge imports only ActPotencyRegress, and Comparator rejects a Solution proof through a lemma outside the Challenge imports); this instance states the same conditional. McTaggart: one bounded attempt; he escapes at the link, not the logic: his § 511 answer (recorded in ATTEMPT-MCTAGGART-NOE-II-RETORSION-REPLY) denies the change link outright and, with the open bridge STMT-MOTION-IS-A-CHANGE, the Eleatic motion link; the opinionGate model satisfies his 1908 bundle, the 1927 answer, the bridge and both held positions while both links fail. Rejected: registering McTaggart as instance_of_schema (the instance fails; an escape record is not an instance) and a refutes relation for the Eleatic instance (its link is open, #391). Frontier delta: none.
